_note: Final QA of the 82 regenerated covers (second and final regeneration). Every new tile was opened at full size (1024x1024) with read_image and judged on R1 genre match, R2 skin palette/medium, R3 craft (text/lettering/blankness/thumbnail legibility), R4 cliche. Each of the 82 new files was also checked programmatically against its _rejected original: no pair is byte-identical (all md5 differ) and the coarse 16x16 pixel difference ranges 10.2-63.5, so nothing was re-shipped unchanged. Rejected originals were additionally opened at full size for the failure candidates and for the soviet/comic defect families, which confirmed the persisting defects (e.g. old soviet afro-house already read 'ARED HOUSE', old soviet black-metal 'PNEOVE').
